meta.name: Tata Rekavo harmonized Fire Radiative Power - Bolivia (experimental)

grid.cell_index: row * cols + col; row = floor((lat-lat0)/deg), col = floor((lon-lon0)/deg)

meta.cells_note: only cell-months with harmonized FRP > 0 (rounded to 0.1 MW)
meta.factor_definition: sum of VIIRS S-NPP FRP / sum of MODIS {aqua|terra} FRP, vegetation fires, clean overlap days 2012-02-01..2025-12-31; applied to each MODIS hotspot's FRP, S-NPP (and NOAA-20 fill) FRP used as observed
meta.validation_note: Aqua FRP x factor fitted without the held-out year vs S-NPP FRP observed, zone-months with >= 1 MW; mdape = median, p90 = 90th percentile of the absolute percentage error

error_model.formula: relative_error(n) = min(1, c * n^(-p)) where n = harmonized FRP (MW) in the zone-month; for months before viirs_start add the systematic term in quadrature: sqrt(rel^2 + sys[year]^2); months from viirs_start are observed (no translation error)
error_model.meaning: median absolute relative error (about half of zone-months fall inside the band)

meta.experimental_rule: true when the country leave-one-year-out mdape_pct > 25
sources: NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 (Terra, Aqua) standard processing
NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20) standard processing
